responsibility: Tests the extern ABI registry’s public invariants by checking name lookup results and verifying that each ABI’s hard-coded index stays synchronized with the module’s canonical ABI data table.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the crate-root `src/tests.rs`, this `tests.rs` is specific to the `extern_abi` submodule, checking ABI-name parsing/error cases and that each ABI’s `index()` matches the canonical `AbiDatas` table instead of general crate-level utility invariants.
